purpose: Teach: エディション/マウント/薄型/最速/ユーザビリティ/ポテンシャル/ゼネコン/ウエイト

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 限定エディションの企画を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the limited edition proposal.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-leaning energy. Decisive opening. Steady pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone setting the agenda — friendly but in control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議でマウントを取る言動は控えます
lines.en: Got it. I'll make sure not to dominate the conversation in the meeting.
lines.style: Quick, earnest agreement. Acknowledges the feedback without defensiveness. Slight self-awareness in the delivery — straightforward commitment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 薄型サンプルを発注しましょう
lines.style: Same authoritative clarity as before. Brief and direct. The instruction lands with quiet confidence — no inflation needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。最速の見積もりを提示します
lines.en: Understood. I'll get the fastest quote possible for you.
lines.style: Responsive, efficient tone. Slight lift at 「最速」moment — showing he's taking the speed seriously. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ユーザビリティテストを実施しましょう
lines.style: Same measured authority. She's building the project systematically. Clear without being commanding — this is just the next logical step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。チームのポテンシャル評価を整理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll pull together the team's capability assessment.
lines.style: Steady, attentive confirmation. He's tracking each request and lining up the work. The tone of someone who knows what comes next.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ゼネコン業界の動向を調査しましょう
lines.en: Let's research the construction industry trends.
lines.style: Still in control, still clear. A slightly wider scope now — she's not just executing, she's setting strategic direction. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修のウエイトを増やします
lines.en: Got it. I'll increase the focus on new-hire training.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly fuller than before — closing the loop. He's consolidated the direction and is ready to move. Professional wrap.
